answer.reason: One event of the story belongs to Pamphylia: John Mark left Paul and Barnabas there and returned to Jerusalem.

clauses.english: was where John Mark left Paul and Barnabas and returned to Jerusalem
clauses.quote: John departing from them returned to Jerusalem

doubts: ACT 2:10 and ACT 27:5 only name Pamphylia in a list of peoples and a sea route, so they were left out.
Paul's preaching at Perga (ACT 14:25) belongs to that city, so it was not made a clause.
